text:
akash: quick heads up — i'm starting a terraform refactor this afternoon to split zone-aware gpu profiles out of modules/gpu_profiles. goal: be able to pin instance types per AZ and avoid our current az-affinity/placement churn.

akash: main concerns: state migration, iam role refs, kms alias ownership, and minimal downtime for Dedicated fleets. want a short migration checklist. :eyes:

jamie: +1 on the split. quick q: are you planning an in-place state move (terraform state mv) or a redeploy with import? state mv is faster but worry about workspace mismatches.

akash: leaning to state mv with a canary workspace. plan: create modules/gpu_zone_profiles (new module), update gitops to point staging -> new module, then run state mv for the staging workspace only, run plan, smoke test, promote. avoid recreating resources.

lina: watch IAM role detachment — our current tf module implicitly creates iam roles that other modules reference by data sources. if we mv state you need to keep the resource addresses stable or add tf 0.15+ alias blocks. Also KMS aliases: the new module changes the alias naming, which triggered drift alerts in last run.

infra-bot: CI: gitops-staging plan failed 2m ago — diff shows kms_alias name change and 1 iam_role resource marked tainted. (see: ci.redwood/example-plan-#512)

akash: noted. plan to add a compatibility shim: keep old alias in new module for 2 releases and a flag `preserve_legacy_alias = true` default true for canary. after 2 releases we flip and remove. that should stop drift.

terraform-bot: suggested commands:
```
# in staging workspace
git checkout tf-split-gpu
terraform init -upgrade
terraform state mv 'module.gpu_profiles.module.pool' 'module.gpu_zone_profiles.module.pool'
terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars
```

jamie: also update the gitops helm values for the node-autoscaler: we changed scaleDownDelaySeconds in the chart last month, combined with different AZ balancing we might see transient pod eviction. add a quick smoke: deploy a small inference job pinned to a node in each AZ.

lina: for IAM refs i'll add output aliases that downstream modules can consume for 2 releases. and i'll open a tiny script to check for dangling role attachments across accounts before we run mv.

akash: cost note — splitting lets us reduce p4d count in low-util azs and replace with cheaper a100s where throughput permits. i'll include a cost projection in the PR. expect ~8-12% monthly GPU spend reduction on staging footprint.

sre-oncall: reminder: run the capacity guardrails after migration. if AZ imbalance > 20% for >15m, auto-fallback policy should trigger. i'll keep an eye on alerts.

akash: next steps: i'll open the PR with the module split + `preserve_legacy_alias` flag, add migration doc in repo root named MIGRATE_GPU_SPLIT.md, and coordinate a 30-min window for staging state mv. pinging @jamie and @lina for approvals.

jamie: i'll review the PR and validate the autoscaler vals.

lina: i'll add the IAM/detach check and the KMS shim, then sign off.

akash: thanks — i'll post the exact time here before doing the staging move. :thumbsup:
